themes.description: Users experience frequent app crashes, glitches, and technical issues while trading, leading to significant losses and frustration.
themes.business_impact: Users are losing their money due to delayed execution of orders, incorrect price discrepancies, and failed trades, resulting in increased financial loss and decreased customer trust.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The app's instability and technical issues are likely caused by poor code quality, inadequate testing, and insufficient resources allocated to maintain and improve the platform.
themes.action_plan:
• Improve app stability by rewriting critical modules, implementing proper error handling, and enhancing testing procedures
• Conduct user acceptance testing to identify and fix critical issues
• Allocate additional resources to maintain and improve the platform

themes.description: Users are frustrated with the lack of effectiveness and responsiveness of the customer support service, leading to unaddressed issues and unresolved problems.
themes.business_impact: This theme could lead to increased customer dissatisfaction, reduced retention, and ultimately, revenue loss as customers seek alternatives with better support services.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The customer support service may lack adequate resources, training, or infrastructure to handle the volume and complexity of customer inquiries, resulting in delays and unhelpful responses.
themes.action_plan:
• Conduct a thorough review of the customer support process and infrastructure
• Provide additional training for customer support agents
• Increase the number of support agents and improve workflow efficiency
• Implement a more effective ticketing and escalation system
• Introduce a proactive outreach mechanism to address customer concerns before they become issues.

themes.description: Users are complaining about high brokerage charges, inconsistent fees, and excessive charges that can lead to significant losses.
themes.business_impact: High brokerage charges can result in substantial financial losses for users, potentially deterring them from using the platform.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Inconsistent and high brokerage charges may be a result of a flawed pricing strategy or inefficient fee calculation process.
themes.action_plan: • Re-evaluate and optimize brokerage charges to ensure they are competitive, reasonable, and consistent. Implement clear and transparent fee disclosure to users.
